## Change

Describe the workflow or documentation correction and its supporting sources.

## Verification

- [ ] Current model IDs, route restrictions and availability match linked sources
- [ ] All eleven README variants carry the same changed workflow and case inventory
- [ ] Creator attribution, source links, historical prompts and media are preserved
- [ ] New instructional prompts are identified as repository-authored examples
- [ ] Menu anchors, relative files, media references and changed external destinations checked
- [ ] Documentation validator, helper checks and `git diff --check` passed
- [ ] API/schema/mock/live validation states and any remaining limitations reported separately

## Related surfaces

List linked API/skill repositories when relevant. Changing this guide does not release those packages or prove their runtime support. Do not include secrets or paid-test credentials.
